text:
Alex: Escalating Quantapulse trial - embeddings calls are getting 403 quota_exceeded during their ingest. Support opened CSUP-77777. They have a demo Friday; customer said renewal could be at risk if pilot doesn't complete.

Priya: @Alex can you paste an error sample and which region/account? I'll take lead on comms and schedule the enablement touch.

Alex: Sample log: ```403: quota_exceeded - unit=embed_tokens - allowed=100k - used=112345 - at=2026-03-25T14:02:11Z``` Account: quantapulse-09, region=us-east-1. They ramped quickly with a bulk embed job.

Marcus: I can temporarily bump their quota for 48h and add a soft throttle to prevent runaway. Need account id and expected spike QPS.

Alex: Account id above. Expected steady embed QPS ~5, spikes up to ~150 during large ingest.

Holly: I'll prepare a brief customer note and propose a 30-min enablement Friday 09:00 AM ET to assist with best-practices for batching and retry handling. Also recommend a 60-day renewal_watch tag.

Priya: Plan (owners):
- Marcus: apply 48h quota bump + soft throttle
- Priya: run enablement call + send checklist
- Alex: keep CSUP-77777 updated with debug bundle
- Holly: draft proactive comms and capture feedback during call

Marcus: Temporary quota bump applied: embeds_quota=200k for quantapulse-09 until 2026-03-27T14:00:00Z; soft_throttle=enabled; monitoring enabled on embed_rate and errors.

Alex: Added debug bundle + sample traces to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CSUP-77777. Customer replied: "Thanks. We need the demo to go well or we'll pause."

Priya: Sending interim message: "We've applied a temporary quota increase and enabled safeguards. We'll walk through ingestion best practices on the enablement call and follow up with a 30-day health plan."

Holly: Invite sent for Friday 09:00 AM ET. Customer accepted. I'll ask for their ingest window details so we can supervise.

Marcus: I'll watch metrics during the ingest; if error rate spikes again I'll revert and escalate.

Priya: Post-call plan: 1) share batching checklist and sample client snippet, 2) propose 1-month pro-active monitor with weekly reports, 3) tag renewal_watch=60d and loop Finance for concession if SLA breach >24h.

Holly: Customer sentiment on ticket: "Appreciate the urgency. If the enablement helps we'll likely renew." Good sign. I'll capture notes + NPS on the call.

Alex: Thanks team. I'll keep CSUP-77777 updated and post the post-call summary here. :thumbsup:
